username.label: [%key:common::config_entries::username::label%]
username.description: Your Pandora username or email address

quality.label: Audio quality
quality.description: Audio quality to request from Pandora. High quality is only available with an active Pandora subscription. If your account is not eligible for high-quality streaming, standard quality will be used regardless of this setting.

option_descriptions.high: Requires an active Pandora subscription; otherwise playback falls back to Standard.

socks_url.label: Socks proxy server
socks_url.description: This socks proxy is only used to route Pandora network traffic through. The server address should be written as: ip_address:port (or socks5://ip_address:port)

takeover_stream.label: Take over stream
takeover_stream.description: Pandora only allows one active stream at a time per account. You can request that Pandora terminate any existing stream on other devices and allow streaming here. You must manually restart playback after performing this action.

manifest.description: Pandora is a music and podcast streaming service that creates personalized radio stations based on your favorite songs and artists.
